title: TMC Supporters and Leaders Protest in Kolkata Over Alleged Attack on Home
seoTitle: Kolkata TMC protest over house attack

tea.why: Protesters and party members demonstrated following an alleged early-morning attack on Abhishek Banerjee's residence in Kolkata.
tea.want: Demonstrators expressed anger over the alleged assault, disruption of festivities, and perceived police inaction.
tea.changed: Nov 7, 2026: TMC supporters and party leaders staged a demonstration outside the Kalighat residence following overnight clashes.

summary: Trinamool Congress supporters and leaders, including Mamata Banerjee, staged a protest outside Abhishek Banerjee's residence in the Kalighat area of Kolkata. The demonstration followed overnight clashes between TMC workers and political opponents after an alleged early-morning attack on the residence during Kali Puja preparations. Protesters raised slogans against the police and expressed outrage over the incident, alleging political intimidation and the disruption of traditional festivities. Authorities deployed a large police contingent, sealed off the area, imposed prohibitory orders, and detained several individuals in connection with the overnight confrontation.
demands: Action against those involved in the alleged attack
End to political intimidation and police restrictions
response: Police deployed a large contingent to seal off the area, imposed prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the BNSS, and detained several individuals following the overnight clashes.

arrests.text: Police detained several people in connection with the clashes.

injuries.text: At least eight people were reportedly injured, three of them seriously.

updates.text: TMC supporters gathered outside Abhishek Banerjee's home in Kolkata, raising slogans against the police over overnight clashes.
